_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 126 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use. Unlock and Requirement transcribed from the in-game challenge text (source: Battlefield 6), recorded 2026-08-01.
name: C-4 Explosives

description.text: A bundle of high explosive charges that can be remote detonated after placement. Can cause massive destruction to structures, vehicles, and infantry.
